style.styleTitle: Premier Decorations Ltd 6ft Multi Acton Lit LED Birch Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Add a colourful illuminated feature to your Christmas decorations with this 1.8 m lit birch tree. The stylish design is enhanced by 120 multi colour LEDs and features 8 multi action effects, including combination, waves, sequential, Slo-Glo, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash and steady on. Complete with a 5 m lead cable and a convenient timer function with 8 hours on followed by 16 hours off, it is easy to enjoy your display each day. Perfect for adding a bright and eye-catching finishing touch to Christmas displays, this illuminated birch tree creates a beautiful focal point wherever it is placed.
